Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
It comes down to your personal preferences for comfort, space, and setup:
• The Pod is a fantastic choice if you want full cold immersion at a lower price point and have limited floor space. However, its upright format means you'll be squatting or sitting upright rather than fully stretching out.
• The Plunge gives you the classic, full-length tub experience where you can lie back completely. If lying down for deep relaxation is important to your routine, the extra investment in The Plunge is worth it.
